purpose: Enable vmapple + apple-gfx (libreims_vgpu) under aarch64 TCG on Linux x86-64, add XNU arm64 pointer-authentication and PSCI TCG support, and order virtio-sound-pci capabilities with JACK_INFO/CHMAP_INFO so macOS 27 AppleVirtIOSound registers Apple Virtual Sound Device

Support compile-time RVG_GUEST_PAGE_SHIFT=14 for 16 KiB arm64 guest pages on 4 KiB x86-64 hosts (including IOSurface page mappers), add Ctrl+Alt+F fullscreen toggle to the Linux SDL3 window, approximate runtime MTLSamplerMinMagFilterCubic with Linear and promote sampleCount = 2 to 4 (preserving guest-visible sample_count and translating 2x<->4x buffer-texture blit copies) on 4x-only Vulkan drivers (Mesa Lavapipe) outside REIMS_VGPU_STRICT=1 so apps such as Weather.app and Chess.app render cleanly, and record git source URLs in Cargo.lock for --locked builds
